title: OLX.ba Rent
description: For people renting a home: what a fair monthly rent is, what amenities add, and how quickly rentals leave OLX.

filters.name: category
filters.label: Category
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT property_type AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE property_type IS NOT NULL AND property_type <> 'daily_rent' ORDER BY 1

filters.name: rooms
filters.label: Rooms
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(rooms,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

filters.name: neighborhood
filters.label: Neighborhood
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

filters.name: subject_neighborhood
filters.label: Neighborhood (overrides the link)
filters.options_sql: SELECT name AS __value FROM lean.neighborhoods ORDER BY 1

filters.name: subject_rooms
filters.label: Rooms (overrides the link)
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(rooms,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fair asking rent
panels.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT article_id, deal, property_type, neighborhood, sqm, rooms, price, latitude, longitude FROM lean.listings /* unfiltered */ WHERE article_id = NULLIF(${subject}, '')::bigint), subject AS (SELECT (SELECT article_id FROM linked) AS article_id, coalesce((SELECT deal FROM linked), 'rent') AS deal, coalesce((SELECT property_type FROM linked), NULLIF(${category}, 'All')) AS property_type, coalesce(NULLIF(${subject_neighborhood}, 'All'), (SELECT neighborhood FROM linked)) AS neighborhood, coalesce(NULLIF(${subject_sqm}, '')::numeric, (SELECT sqm FROM linked)) AS sqm, coalesce(NULLIF(${subject_rooms}, 'All'), (SELECT rooms FROM linked)) AS rooms, (SELECT price FROM linked) AS price, (SELECT latitude FROM linked WHERE NULLIF(${subject_neighborhood}, 'All') IS NULL) AS latitude, (SELECT longitude FROM linked WHERE NULLIF(${subject_neighborhood}, 'All') IS NULL) AS longitude), pool AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (article_id) * FROM (SELECT l.article_id, 'active' AS status, l.title, l.url, l.deal, l.property_type, l.neighborhood, l.rooms, l.sqm, l.price, l.latitude, l.longitude, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - l.first_seen AS days_listed FROM lean.listings /* unfiltered */ l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.article_id, 'exited', e.title, e.url, e.deal, e.property_type, e.neighborhood, e.rooms, e.sqm, e.price, e.latitude, e.longitude, e.occurred_at - e.opened_at FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events /* unfiltered */ e WHERE e.event_type = 'closed' AND e.occurred_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 180) candidates ORDER BY article_id, status), comps AS (SELECT p.*, round((p.price / p.sqm)::numeric, CASE WHEN p.deal = 'sale' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS ppm2, d.distance_km, d.distance_km IS NULL AS unplaced, coalesce(d.distance_km, CASE WHEN s.neighborhood IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN p.neighborhood = s.neighborhood THEN 1 ELSE 5 END) + CASE WHEN s.rooms IS NULL OR p.rooms = s.rooms THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + 4 * abs(p.sqm - s.sqm) / s.sqm AS score FROM pool p CROSS JOIN subject s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT round((111.32 * sqrt(power(p.latitude - s.latitude, 2) + power((p.longitude - s.longitude) * cos(radians(s.latitude)), 2)))::numeric, 2) AS distance_km) d WHERE s.sqm > 0 AND p.deal = s.deal AND p.sqm BETWEEN greatest(5, s.sqm * 0.75) AND s.sqm * 1.25 AND p.price >= CASE WHEN p.deal = 'sale' THEN 3000 ELSE 50 END AND (s.property_type IS NULL OR p.property_type = s.property_type) AND p.article_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.article_id ORDER BY score, p.article_id LIMIT 20) SELECT count(c.article_id) AS comps, round((percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.ppm2) * s.sqm)::numeric, CASE WHEN s.deal = 'sale' THEN -3 ELSE -1 END) AS fair_low, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.ppm2) * s.sqm)::numeric, CASE WHEN s.deal = 'sale' THEN -3 ELSE -1 END) AS fair_price, round((percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.ppm2) * s.sqm)::numeric, CASE WHEN s.deal = 'sale' THEN -3 ELSE -1 END) AS fair_high, round((100.0 * (s.price / NULLIF(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.ppm2) * s.sqm, 0) - 1))::numeric, 1) AS ask_vs_fair_change_pct, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.days_listed) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'exited'))::numeric, 0) AS exit_days FROM subject s LEFT JOIN comps c ON TRUE GROUP BY s.sqm, s.deal, s.price
panels.description: Median KM/m² of the comparables × the subject's area. Comparables are up to 20 listings of the same deal and property type within ±25% of the area, active or exited in the last 180 days, nearest first. Page filters do not apply here.

panels.title: Comparable listings
panels.description: Nearest first. Exited listings show their last asking rent. Distance needs map pins on both listings.
panels.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT article_id, deal, property_type, neighborhood, sqm, rooms, price, latitude, longitude FROM lean.listings /* unfiltered */ WHERE article_id = NULLIF(${subject}, '')::bigint), subject AS (SELECT (SELECT article_id FROM linked) AS article_id, coalesce((SELECT deal FROM linked), 'rent') AS deal, coalesce((SELECT property_type FROM linked), NULLIF(${category}, 'All')) AS property_type, coalesce(NULLIF(${subject_neighborhood}, 'All'), (SELECT neighborhood FROM linked)) AS neighborhood, coalesce(NULLIF(${subject_sqm}, '')::numeric, (SELECT sqm FROM linked)) AS sqm, coalesce(NULLIF(${subject_rooms}, 'All'), (SELECT rooms FROM linked)) AS rooms, (SELECT price FROM linked) AS price, (SELECT latitude FROM linked WHERE NULLIF(${subject_neighborhood}, 'All') IS NULL) AS latitude, (SELECT longitude FROM linked WHERE NULLIF(${subject_neighborhood}, 'All') IS NULL) AS longitude), pool AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (article_id) * FROM (SELECT l.article_id, 'active' AS status, l.title, l.url, l.deal, l.property_type, l.neighborhood, l.rooms, l.sqm, l.price, l.latitude, l.longitude, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - l.first_seen AS days_listed FROM lean.listings /* unfiltered */ l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.article_id, 'exited', e.title, e.url, e.deal, e.property_type, e.neighborhood, e.rooms, e.sqm, e.price, e.latitude, e.longitude, e.occurred_at - e.opened_at FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events /* unfiltered */ e WHERE e.event_type = 'closed' AND e.occurred_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 180) candidates ORDER BY article_id, status), comps AS (SELECT p.*, round((p.price / p.sqm)::numeric, CASE WHEN p.deal = 'sale' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS ppm2, d.distance_km, d.distance_km IS NULL AS unplaced, coalesce(d.distance_km, CASE WHEN s.neighborhood IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN p.neighborhood = s.neighborhood THEN 1 ELSE 5 END) + CASE WHEN s.rooms IS NULL OR p.rooms = s.rooms THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + 4 * abs(p.sqm - s.sqm) / s.sqm AS score FROM pool p CROSS JOIN subject s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT round((111.32 * sqrt(power(p.latitude - s.latitude, 2) + power((p.longitude - s.longitude) * cos(radians(s.latitude)), 2)))::numeric, 2) AS distance_km) d WHERE s.sqm > 0 AND p.deal = s.deal AND p.sqm BETWEEN greatest(5, s.sqm * 0.75) AND s.sqm * 1.25 AND p.price >= CASE WHEN p.deal = 'sale' THEN 3000 ELSE 50 END AND (s.property_type IS NULL OR p.property_type = s.property_type) AND p.article_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.article_id ORDER BY score, p.article_id LIMIT 20) SELECT title, url, status, neighborhood, rooms, sqm, price, ppm2, days_listed, distance_km FROM comps ORDER BY score, article_id

panels.title: Active rentals
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT count(*) AS active, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE price >= 50)::numeric, 0) AS median_rent, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN base.sqm >= 5 AND base.price >= 50 THEN base.price / base.sqm END)::numeric, 1) AS median_rent_ppm2, count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 7) AS new_7d, (SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.occurred_at - e.opened_at)::numeric, 0) FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type = 'closed' AND e.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR e.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND e.occurred_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 90) AS median_days_to_exit FROM base

panels.title: Median days to exit · 90 d
panels.description: How long rentals that left OLX in the last 90 days were listed. An exit is not a confirmed letting.

panels.title: Median rent by neighborhood
panels.description: Click an area to filter the page.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT neighborhood, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price)::numeric, 0) AS median_rent, count(*) AS listings FROM base WHERE price >= 50 AND neighborhood IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Median rent by rooms
panels.description: Click a bar to filter the page.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT coalesce(rooms, 'unknown') AS rooms, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price)::numeric, 0) AS median_rent, count(*) AS listings FROM base WHERE price >= 50 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Neighborhoods compared
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), gone AS (SELECT coalesce(e.neighborhood, 'unknown') AS neighborhood, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.occurred_at - e.opened_at) AS days FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type = 'closed' AND e.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR e.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND e.occurred_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 90 GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(b.neighborhood, 'unknown') AS neighborhood, count(*) AS listings, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.price) FILTER (WHERE b.price >= 50)::numeric, 0) AS median_rent, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.sqm >= 5 AND b.price >= 50 THEN b.price / b.sqm END)::numeric, 1) AS median_rent_ppm2, count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.first_seen >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 7) AS new_7d, round(max(gone.days)::numeric, 0) AS median_days_to_exit FROM base b LEFT JOIN gone ON gone.neighborhood = coalesce(b.neighborhood, 'unknown') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY listings DESC, neighborhood

panels.title: What amenities are worth
panels.description: Median rent with and without each amenity among matching rentals. Listings that do not state the amenity are left out of both columns.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), flags AS (SELECT a.amenity, CASE lower((a.raw)::text) WHEN 'true' THEN 'Yes' WHEN '1' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'da' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'yes' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'false' THEN 'No' WHEN '0' THEN 'No' WHEN 'ne' THEN 'No' WHEN 'no' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS flag, b.price FROM base b CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('Furnished', coalesce(coalesce(nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'opremljenost', ''), nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'namjesten', ''), nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'namjestena', ''), NULL), b.extra->>'furnished')), ('Pets allowed', coalesce(nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'kucni-ljubimci', ''), NULL)), ('Bills included', coalesce(nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'ukljucen-trosak-rezija', ''), NULL)), ('Parking', coalesce(b.parking::text, coalesce(nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'parking', ''), NULL))), ('Air conditioning', coalesce(nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'klima', ''), NULL)), ('Lift', coalesce(b.elevator::text, coalesce(nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'lift', ''), NULL))), ('Balcony', coalesce(nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'balkon', ''), NULL)), ('Suitable for students', coalesce(nullif(b.extra->'characteristics'->>'za-studente', ''), NULL))) a(amenity, raw) WHERE b.price >= 50), grouped AS (SELECT amenity, count(*) FILTER (WHERE flag = 'Yes') AS with_amenity, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE flag = 'Yes') AS rent_with, count(*) FILTER (WHERE flag = 'No') AS without_amenity, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE flag = 'No') AS rent_without FROM flags GROUP BY amenity) SELECT amenity, with_amenity, round(rent_with::numeric, 0) AS median_rent_with, without_amenity, round(rent_without::numeric, 0) AS median_rent_without, round((100.0 * (rent_with / NULLIF(rent_without, 0) - 1))::numeric, 1) AS difference_pct FROM grouped ORDER BY difference_pct DESC NULLS LAST, amenity

panels.title: Days on market before exit · 90 d
panels.description: How quickly rentals leave OLX. An exit is not a confirmed letting.
panels.sql: WITH exits AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.article_id, e.deal, e.title, e.url, e.neighborhood, e.rooms, e.sqm, e.price AS final_price, e.occurred_at AS closed_at, e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at, (e.occurred_at - e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type = 'closed' AND e.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR e.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND e.occurred_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 90) SELECT CASE WHEN days_listed >= 180 THEN '180+ d' ELSE (days_listed / 20 * 20) || '–' || (days_listed / 20 * 20 + 19) || ' d' END AS days_bracket, count(*) AS listings FROM exits WHERE days_listed >= 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(days_listed)

panels.title: Exit share by rooms · 30 d
panels.description: Exits in the last 30 days ÷ (those exits + active rentals). Higher means faster turnover.
panels.sql: WITH exits AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.article_id, e.deal, e.title, e.url, e.neighborhood, e.rooms, e.sqm, e.price AS final_price, e.occurred_at AS closed_at, e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at, (e.occurred_at - e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type = 'closed' AND e.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR e.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND e.occurred_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30), base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT rooms, round(100.0 * sum(exits) / NULLIF(sum(exits) + sum(actives), 0), 1) AS exit_ratio FROM (SELECT coalesce(rooms, 'unknown') AS rooms, count(*) AS exits, 0::bigint AS actives FROM exits GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT coalesce(rooms, 'unknown'), 0, count(*) FROM base GROUP BY 1) population GROUP BY rooms ORDER BY rooms

panels.title: New in the last 3 days
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT title, url, neighborhood, rooms, sqm, price, round(CASE WHEN base.sqm >= 5 AND base.price >= 50 THEN base.price / base.sqm END::numeric, 1) AS rent_ppm2, first_seen FROM base WHERE first_seen >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 3 ORDER BY first_seen DESC, article_id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Below their neighborhood rent
panels.description: Matching rentals at least 15% under the median rent per m² of all active rentals with the same neighborhood and rooms (5 or more).
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), medians AS (SELECT neighborhood, rooms, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.sqm >= 5 AND r.price >= 50 THEN r.price / r.sqm END) AS median_ppm2, count(CASE WHEN r.sqm >= 5 AND r.price >= 50 THEN r.price / r.sqm END) AS n FROM lean.listings /* unfiltered */ r WHERE r.closed_at IS NULL AND r.deal = 'rent' GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT b.title, b.url, b.neighborhood, b.rooms, b.sqm, b.price, round(CASE WHEN b.sqm >= 5 AND b.price >= 50 THEN b.price / b.sqm END::numeric, 1) AS rent_ppm2, round((100.0 * (CASE WHEN b.sqm >= 5 AND b.price >= 50 THEN b.price / b.sqm END / m.median_ppm2 - 1))::numeric, 1) AS vs_median_pct, b.first_seen FROM base b JOIN medians m ON m.neighborhood = b.neighborhood AND m.rooms IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.rooms WHERE m.n >= 5 AND CASE WHEN b.sqm >= 5 AND b.price >= 50 THEN b.price / b.sqm END <= 0.85 * m.median_ppm2 ORDER BY vs_median_pct, b.article_id LIMIT 25

panels.title: Recent rent reductions
panels.sql: WITH prices AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, price, lag(price) OVER (PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY price_date, id) AS previous_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE price IS NOT NULL AND source = 'api_price_history'), cuts AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, previous_price, price FROM prices WHERE previous_price > price) SELECT l.title, l.url, l.neighborhood, l.rooms, c.previous_price AS was, c.price AS now, round(100.0 * (1 - c.price / c.previous_price), 1) AS cut_pct, c.price_date FROM cuts c JOIN lean.listings l USING (article_id) WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND l.deal = 'rent' AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) ORDER BY c.price_date DESC, cut_pct DESC, l.article_id LIMIT 25
